concepts.proposed_markdown: Bearer-secured `POST /v2/contracts/commits/archive` deactivates a contract-level or customer-level commit while preserving historical records. Archival is blocked until every finalized usage invoice to which the commit was applied and every finalized commit-payment invoice is voided; the documented correction flow then regenerates the voided usage invoice without the archived commit. The archived commit has a null ledger, zero remaining balance, and a fully deactivated access schedule, and is omitted by default from commit and balance lists unless `include_archived` is used. Operators who only need to reduce a grant are routed to access-schedule editing or a manual balance-ledger entry instead. [[source-metronome-api-reference-credits-and-commits-archive-a-commit]]
warnings: Preserve the distinction between historical-record retention and the documented null-ledger, zero-balance, full-access-schedule deactivation effects.
Do not generalize the example regeneration sequence into downstream-provider, refund, payment, tax, accounting, or atomicity guarantees.
